name: Primus Cube Open - May 2018

venue.name: [Primus Public School](http://www.primusschool.com)
venue.address: Primus School, Off. Sarjapur Road, Chikanayakanahalli Village, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560035

information: **Online registration ends on 3rd May, 2018. On the spot registration is available. Visit registration and payment tab for details.** **First time participants** Step 1 - Sign-up on WCA Step 2 - [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PrimusCubeOpen2018/register) for the competition Step 3 - Pay using the details given in the [payments tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PrimusCubeOpen2018#5269-registration-and-payment). **Other participants** Step 1 - Sign-in using your WCA account. Step 2 - [Register]((https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PrimusCubeOpen2018/register)) for the competition (ensure your WCA id is mentioned) Step 3 - Pay using the details given in the [payments tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PrimusCubeOpen2018#5269-registration-and-payment). Those who have registered on WCA but have not made the payment will be considered as OTS registrations. **Results** The competition results will take a few days to update on WCA once the competition is over. For live results you can check www.cubecomps.com **Special Prizes** Under-8, under-10 & under-12! Leave a WhatsApp message on +91 9052529279 if you have additional queries.
